### EQ001 — Amplified Bernoulli probability

*Maps an amplitude a and amplification count m_k to the good-state probability sampled by every numerical target.*

$$
\theta_a=\arcsin\sqrt a,\qquad p_k(a)=\sin^2\!\left[(2m_k+1)\theta_a\right].
$$

status: `verified` · source: equation: Eqs. (2)-(3), label Qj2

Numerical form:

```
theta = asin(sqrt(a)); p = sin((2*m + 1)*theta)**2
```

Code: `scripts/reproduce.py::amplified_probability`


### EQ002 — Joint binomial log-likelihood

*Defines the independent maximum-likelihood estimator used for Fig. 2 and Fig. A.*

$$
\ell(\theta_a;\mathbf h)=\sum_{k=0}^{M}\left[h_k\ln p_k+(N_k-h_k)\ln(1-p_k)\right],\qquad \hat a=\sin^2\!\left(\arg\max_{0\leq\theta\leq\pi/2}\ell(\theta;\mathbf h)\right).
$$

status: `verified` · derived from: `EQ001` · source: equation: Eqs. (4)-(6), labels LHpart, LH, ML estimate

Numerical form:

```
log_likelihood = h @ log(p_grid) + (N-h) @ log1p(-p_grid); a_hat = sin(theta_at_global_max)**2
```

Code: `scripts/reproduce.py::maximum_likelihood_estimates`


### EQ003 — Fisher information and Cramer-Rao error

*Provides the analytic lower-bound curves and scaling checks in Fig. 2.*

$$
\mathcal I(a)=\frac{1}{a(1-a)}\sum_{k=0}^{M}N_k(2m_k+1)^2,\qquad \epsilon_{\rm CR}=\mathcal I(a)^{-1/2}.
$$

status: `verified` · derived from: `EQ001`, `EQ002` · source: equation: Eqs. (7)-(10), especially Eq. (10), label Fisher_final

Numerical form:

```
fisher = sum(N_k*(2*m_k+1)**2)/(a*(1-a)); cr = 1/sqrt(fisher)
```

Code: `scripts/reproduce.py::fisher_information`


### EQ004 — Total query count

$$

$$

### EQ005 — Exact LIS and EIS sequence sums

*Converts the paper's schedules to exact query counts and Fisher bounds.*

$$
\begin{aligned}N_{q}^{\rm LIS}&=N_{\rm shot}(M+1)^2, &\sum N_k(2m_k+1)^2&=\frac{N_{\rm shot}(M+1)(2M+1)(2M+3)}{3},\\N_q^{\rm EIS}&=N_{\rm shot}(2^{M+1}+M-1), &\sum N_k(2m_k+1)^2&=N_{\rm shot}\left[\frac{4^{M+1}-4}{3}+2^{M+2}+M-3\right].\end{aligned}
$$

status: `verified` · derived from: `EQ003`, `EQ004` · source: section: Sec. 3.2, LIS/EIS bullet list and following paragraph

Numerical form:

```
lis: m=arange(M+1); eis: m=[0]+[2**(k-1) for k in 1..M]; sums are checked against direct enumeration
```

Code: `scripts/reproduce.py::schedule`, `scripts/reproduce.py::verify_schedule_sums`

### EQ007 — Conventional amplitude-estimation error envelope

*Provides the deterministic conventional comparator in Fig. A.*

$$
Q_m=2^m-1,\quad y\in\{\lfloor Q_m\theta_a/\pi\rfloor,\lceil Q_m\theta_a/\pi\rceil,Q_m-\lfloor Q_m\theta_a/\pi\rfloor,Q_m-\lceil Q_m\theta_a/\pi\rceil\},\quad e_m=\max_y\left|\sin^2(\pi y/Q_m)-a\right|.
$$

status: `verified` · derived from: `EQ001`, `EQ004` · source: section: Appendix A, paragraph defining the four nearest integers

Numerical form:

```
evaluate floor/ceil candidates on both symmetric phase branches and retain the largest absolute amplitude error
```
